serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: AchieveIt helps federal government agencies manage mission critical plans and initiatives. Our cloud-based software platform empowers teams to focus on executing strategic initiatives instead of working on manual tasks. With AchieveIt, leaders can monitor progress on key plans and initiatives in real-time using a single, automated platform that establishes uniformity and visibility across plans and initiatives, promotes accountability throughout the agency, and enables informed decision-making. Trusted by organizations such as the Department of Veterans Affairs, The Joint Pathology Center, and the United States Air Force, AchieveIt accelerates IT modernization efforts by helping federal agencies plan, manage, and report their mission-critical plans and initiatives.
